findings.text: Compare and swap encoding construction accepts a result register together with address and value registers plus a width selector and an ordering selector, succeeding only for word and doubleword widths and combining a base opcode with size, ordering and register fields.
Register offset load store tail processing clears two control positions in the assembled word before merging a caller supplied ordering attribute and returning the completed encoding.

Bitfield move encoding construction accepts destination and source registers plus rotation and width immediates together with a width selector and a move flavour distinguishing plain, unsigned and signed forms.

Bitfield construction succeeds only for recognized flavours and widths, requires immediates to fit within a width dependent allowance that is narrower for 32 bit and wider for 64 bit with size related flags set in the latter case, and signals any violation with a fault sentinel encoding.

Shifted register add and subtract encoding construction accepts three registers plus a shift amount together with a width selector and an operation selector covering add, subtract and flag setting variants.

Shifted add subtract construction succeeds only for recognized operations and widths, requires the shift amount to fit within the capacity implied by the width, sets a size flag for 64 bit, and signals any violation with a fault sentinel.

Extended register add and subtract encoding construction accepts three registers plus an extension control and a small shift amount together with a width selector and an operation selector covering plain and flag setting adds and subtracts.

Extended add subtract construction succeeds only for recognized operations and widths, requires the shift amount to lie between zero and four inclusive, merges extension control and shift into a shared immediate field, sets a size flag for 64 bit, and signals violations with a fault sentinel.
Single source data processing encoding construction accepts destination and source registers plus a width selector and an operation selector covering three byte reversal widths.

Single source reversal construction requires 64 bit width for the widest reversal, accepts either width otherwise with a size flag set for 64 bit, and signals unrecognized operation or width with a fault sentinel.

Two source data processing encoding construction accepts three registers plus a width selector and an operation selector covering unsigned division, signed division and register controlled shift and rotate forms.
Three source data processing encoding construction accepts four registers plus a width selector and an operation selector distinguishing multiply add from multiply subtract.
Two and three source construction succeed only for recognized operations and widths, set a size flag for 64 bit, and signal violations with a fault sentinel.
The OPC2 decode mask has value 0x7 and its field begins at bit position 5.
The CRM decode mask has value 0xf covering a four bit field.
Extract encoding construction accepts a width selector together with three registers and a least significant bit position.

Extract construction allows bit positions up to thirty one for 32 bit width and up to sixty three for 64 bit width, sets size related flags for 64 bit, and signals out of range positions or unrecognized widths with a fault sentinel.

Translation from barrier kind to option value gives fifteen when the kind equals AARCH64_INSN_MB_SY, fourteen for AARCH64_INSN_MB_ST, thirteen for AARCH64_INSN_MB_LD, eleven for AARCH64_INSN_MB_ISH, ten for AARCH64_INSN_MB_ISHST, nine for AARCH64_INSN_MB_ISHLD, seven for AARCH64_INSN_MB_NSH, six for AARCH64_INSN_MB_NSHST and five for AARCH64_INSN_MB_NSHLD, with any other kind producing a fault sentinel.

Data memory barrier and data synchronization barrier encoding construction each accept a barrier kind, translate it through shared option logic, embed the resulting option into bits eleven down to eight of their respective base opcodes, and propagate translation failure as a fault sentinel.

Move from system register encoding construction accepts a destination register and a system register identifier, clears the low twenty bits of a base opcode, inserts the identifier shifted by five positions, and encodes the destination register.

Tag mismatch trampoline serves as an executable entry that preserves caller integer state across a call into tag mismatch handling and then restores state and releases its stack reservation before returning to the faulting context.

Trampoline reserves two hundred fifty six bytes, saves registers x2 through x15 in pairs with x18 saved only when shadow call stack is disabled, forwards link state to the handler, and restores saved registers including frame pointer x29 and link x30 before releasing the reservation.
Position independent memory search provides lookup of the first occurrence of a byte value within a bounded region, returning the address of the match or null when no match exists.

Search narrows the sought value to eight bits, examines eight byte units with parallel match detection before falling back to single byte examination for the remainder, and treats zero remaining length as not found.
Position independent memory comparison provides lexicographic ordering of two bounded regions, returning zero when contents are equal and otherwise a value whose sign reflects unsigned byte ordering.

Comparison handles very short lengths with narrow loads and a byte loop, compares leading and trailing eight byte units with early exit for medium sizes, uses an aligned sixteen byte loop with overlapping edge coverage for large sizes, normalizes byte order on little endian before ordering, and yields magnitude either as normalized sign or as byte difference depending on path.
Position independent memory copy provides transfer of a bounded byte count from source to destination, treating zero count and identical endpoints as successful no operation.

Copy chooses specialized handling for tiny, medium and large counts, proceeds forward except when destination overlaps the source region in which case it proceeds backward, aligns the destination for bulk transfers, and completes edges with overlapping loads and stores.
Position independent copy entry dispatches either to a generic loop or to a hardware copy sequence using operations cpyp then cpym then cpye, selected by processor capability ARM64_HAS_MOPS.

Encoding constructors signal invalid requests by returning AARCH64_BREAK_FAULT, a fault sentinel intended to fault if executed rather than trapping during construction, so callers must validate results and must not emit the sentinel as a normal instruction.
Relies on diagnostic logging facility for reporting invalid encoding requests.
Relies on bitmask construction helper for encoding validation and field insertion.
